body: From the DM-265 review (orchestrator, this run): pin getMetricsSummary invariants (rows equal fresh getEpicGrade; totals over measured epics only; categories from measured runs; until excludes later epics; trend comparable iff delta) and the readingObservations hold: an insert through another connection is not seen by an open hold, and a delete (epicDeletion.ts:23) does not stop it — either enforce the documented precondition (synchronous, one connection, read-only) or clear the hold on any write; add a test that fails if the hold is used across an await.
